profile.headline: AI Researcher, Computer Science Ph.D.
profile.summary:
AI researcher with experience in molecular science and high-frequency trading, specializing in bridging the gap between sophisticated AI research and high-performance software engineering. Proven track record of architecting novel deep learning models in academia and industry, as well as building autonomous, agentic pipelines for feature engineering and model testing. 



My background combines the mathematical rigor of a CS and Math education with the ability to deliver robust, low-latency solutions in non-stationary data environments. Pursued my Ph.D. in the use of deep learning and generative methods for applications in molecular sciences to understand how AI and ML can unlock crucial scientific discoveries. I've had the opportunity to present my research at international conferences and in publications such as ICML and the Royal Society of Chemistry's Chemical Sciences. Whether in a pure research or a core engineering role, I bring a competitive, strategic mindset shaped by my experience as an NCAA athlete and bridge player.

positions.title: Quantitative Researcher
positions.description: Developed and optimized novel deep learning architectures to extract alpha from high-frequency market data, significantly improving predictive accuracy for systematic strategies. Engineered agentic feature pipelines to automate feature discovery and generation, leveraging advanced importance analysis to refine high-dimensional datasets. End-to-end model ownership, from initial research and training to rigorous backtesting and evaluation within a competitive HFT environment
positions.insights: Skills: Grafana · SQL · Quantitative Research · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Polars · Feature Generation · Finance · Python · PyTorch · Deep Learning Research · Electronic Trading · XGBoost · Multi-agent Systems · Streamlit · Feature Selection · Time Series Analysis

positions.title: Doctoral Student
positions.description: Studied the use of machine learning for spectroscopy. Published works in the field of deep learning for chemistry, leading to authorship of papers on the use of graph neural networks and variational methods for chemical prediction tasks. Wrote open source code in support of published papers and other research tasks, including leading the development of TinyGraph, an open-source Python graph library intended for use in machine learning. Designed and trained deep learning methods using PyTorch, handling databases with tens of thousands of molecules with SQL and RDKit for a dissertation on the use of generative models for inverse problems in spectroscopy.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Developed materials for classes in the Computer Science department, taught recitation sections and reviews, led office hours, and graded exams and other materials. T.A.'d for Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning, Introduction to Data Science II, and Computer Science with Applications.

positions.title: Trading Intern
positions.description: Used Python and historical data to research trading strategies on the Fixed Income and Equities desks. Learned and applied financial knowledge and trading strategies for multiple types of markets.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Modeling · Quantitative Research · Microsoft Excel · Model Training · Finance · Python · Feature Engineering · Machine Learning · LightGBM · Data Analysis · Electronic Trading · Microsoft Office · Presentation Skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed a Go service to deliver Aspiration’s historical data and models via REST endpoints to internal and external consumers with Twirp, protobuf, and AWS SNS/SQS. Built decision trees powered by XGBoost to find weaknesses in input data, greatly improving the accuracy and reliability of data, and explored ML and AI techniques related to grammatical inference and replacing missing data.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Git · SQL · Python · Machine Learning · Data Analysis · XGBoost

positions.title: iOS App Developer (intern)
positions.description: Personally developed an iOS app (Swift) for students to track visits to colleges of interest, catalog their experiences, and compare them across a variety of categories. App has reached over 1000 downloads from college counselors and their students across the country

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped organize and run the annual Education Day events. Was a guest speaker, discussing the impact of Scleroderma on family life. Organized fundraising team for Scleroderma Walk, earning top donor in 2014 & 2015.
